name: Hugo
title: Australian Junior Tennis Player
tagline: Rapid development. Competitive results. A strong determination and goal to compete in NCAA Division I tennis.
bio: Since starting tennis in September 2022, Hugo has progressed rapidly to a current UTR of 9+. As a former Super League soccer striker, Hugo brings speed, discipline and a striker's mentality and competitive focus to the court.
ambition: His ambition is to earn a tennis scholarship for a Division I US college while continuing to develop both academically and as an elite tennis athlete.
